Name: Renny's Fox Children
Author: renjaminnifer
Description:
Are you sick of human children? Do you find them loud and annoying? Don't like raccoons (see my other mod) that much? Wanna replace them with cute lil foxes? Well, have I got the thing for you!

Introducing [size=4][i][b]Renny's FOX Children !

[/b][/i][/size]That's right folks, I've made another kid replacement mod! Works the same as the raccoon one, just with foxes! Sprites are from me!

[b][u]Instructions:[/u][/b]

1. Download the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 
2. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
3. Download Renny's Fox Children and open it with something like Win.rar
4. Decide what color fox you want and extract the corresponding folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
5. Enjoy!
